claim.summary: For fixed prime p, input circuits F_i over F_p of total size s/depth Delta, and Boolean B_j=x_j^2-x_j, put A=product_i(1-F_i^(p-1)). No PC-degree, multilinearity-in-x or extension-field preservation is claimed.
